title: Helicopter tour: only the guide speaks
dek: Radio traffic is silent on the harbour tour. The calls still show as text, and the guide is the only voice.
description: On the Hong Kong harbour helicopter tour, radio calls are now silent and shown as text only, so the tour guide is the only voice you hear.
hero_alt: From the helicopter window seat over Central: a Tower call as text on the left and the guide caption at the bottom.
hero_caption: Tower calls appear as text; only the guide speaks.
card_title: Helicopter tour: only the guide speaks
card_sub: Radio traffic shown as text, not spoken

zh.title: 直升機觀光：只有導賞員講嘢
zh.dek: 維港觀光期間無線電通話靜音，通話照樣以文字顯示，只有導賞員把聲。
zh.description: 香港維港直升機觀光之旅而家將無線電通話靜音，只以文字顯示，你只會聽到導賞員講解。
zh.hero_alt: 喺中環上空嘅直升機窗口位：左邊以文字顯示塔台通話，底部有導賞字幕。
zh.hero_caption: 塔台通話以文字顯示，只有導賞員講嘢。

title: The helicopter tour guide now speaks
dek: The harbour scenic tour reads its captions aloud, in English or Cantonese, with the rotors ducking under the voice.
description: The Hong Kong harbour helicopter tour now has a spoken guide: each caption is read aloud in English or Cantonese, with the rotor noise lowered under it.
hero_alt: From the helicopter window seat: Central across Victoria Harbour, with the guide caption and a speaking indicator at the bottom.
hero_caption: Over the harbour, with the guide speaking.
card_title: The helicopter tour guide now speaks
card_sub: Spoken commentary in English and Cantonese

zh.title: 直升機觀光導賞員識講嘢啦
zh.dek: 維港觀光之旅會用英文或者廣東話讀出字幕，導賞員講嘢時旋翼聲會降低。
zh.description: 香港維港直升機觀光之旅而家有語音導賞：每段字幕都會用英文或者廣東話讀出，旋翼聲會喺講嘢時降低。
zh.hero_alt: 喺直升機窗口位望出去：維港對岸嘅中環，底部有導賞字幕同講話指示。
zh.hero_caption: 飛越維港，導賞員講緊嘢。

title: Live stats: how many pilots make it into Kai Tak
dek: A public page that counts every flight on the site: landings, crashes, go-arounds, modes, aircraft, weather and crash causes.
description: Fly Kai Tak's public stats page counts every flight: landing attempts, landings, crashes, modes, aircraft, weather and crash causes. Anonymous.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak stats page with five headline tiles: flights started, landing attempts, successful landings, crashes and missed approaches.
hero_caption: The new stats page at flykaitak.com/stats.

zh.title: 即時數據：有幾多機師成功降落啟德
zh.dek: 一個公開頁面，統計網站上每一次飛行：降落、墜毀、復飛、模式、機種、天氣同墜毀原因。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 公開數據頁統計每次飛行：降落嘗試、成功降落、墜毀、模式、機種、天氣同墜毀原因，全部匿名。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 數據頁，有五格主要數字：開始飛行、降落嘗試、成功降落、墜毀同復飛。
zh.hero_caption: 新數據頁：flykaitak.com/stats。

title: Flight 605: the 747 wreck at the runway end
dek: An optional 1993 scene: a 747-400 with a crushed nose against the seawall, its tail under the water and its fin cut off.
description: Fly Kai Tak can show the Flight 605 wreck: a 747 nose-up on the seawall at the end of Runway 13, tail under water, fin removed. Tick it on the home screen.
hero_alt: A 747 with its nose against the seawall at the end of the Kai Tak runway and its body sloping down into Victoria Harbour, the tail under the water and the fin gone.
hero_caption: The wreck from the harbour: nose on the seawall, body running out into the water.

zh.title: 605 號航班：跑道盡頭嘅 747 殘骸
zh.dek: 1993 年嘅可選場景：一架機頭撞扁、頂住海堤、機尾喺水下、垂直尾翼已被切除嘅 747-400。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 可以顯示 605 號航班殘骸：一架 747 機頭頂住 13 號跑道盡頭海堤，機尾喺水下，垂直尾翼已被拆除。喺主畫面剔選就得。
zh.hero_alt: 一架 747 機頭頂住啟德跑道盡頭嘅海堤，機身斜斜插入維多利亞港，機尾喺水下，垂直尾翼已經冇咗。
zh.hero_caption: 由海港方向睇殘骸：機頭頂住海堤，機身伸出水面。

title: The made-up airlines of Kai Tak
dek: Ten invented airlines, the aircraft they fly and the 1998 cities they serve, from Red Junk Air to the Concorde charter.
description: Meet the made-up airlines at Fly Kai Tak: their codes, tail colours, aircraft and the long-haul and regional routes on the flight board.
hero_alt: Jets on the apron and taxiway at Kai Tak with red and gold tails, and the Hong Kong skyline beyond.
hero_caption: Tail colours tell the airlines apart on the apron.
card_title: The made-up airlines of Kai Tak

zh.title: 啟德嘅虛構航空公司
zh.dek: 十間虛構航空公司、佢哋飛嘅機種，同埋 1998 年佢哋去嘅城市，由 Red Junk Air 到協和包機。
zh.description: 認識 Fly Kai Tak 入面嘅虛構航空公司：代號、機尾顏色、機種，同航班顯示板上嘅長途同區域航線。
zh.hero_alt: 啟德停機坪同滑行道上有紅色同金色機尾嘅客機，遠處係香港天際線。
zh.hero_caption: 睇機尾顏色就分到係邊間航空公司。

title: Bank of China Tower and HSBC rebuilt
dek: Central's two most famous towers now match the real buildings: the Bank of China's prisms and bracing, lit at night, and HSBC's masts and trusses.
description: The Bank of China Tower and the HSBC Main Building are rebuilt to match the real towers, with the Bank of China's bracing lit as lines of light at night.
hero_alt: The Bank of China Tower at night, its X-bracing and roof edges lit as white-blue lines.
hero_caption: The Bank of China Tower at night.
card_title: Bank of China and HSBC rebuilt
card_sub: Central's towers, as they really look

zh.title: 中銀大廈同匯豐總行重新砌過
zh.dek: 中環兩座最出名嘅大廈而家更貼近真實：中銀嘅三角柱同支撐，夜晚亮燈，同匯豐嘅桁柱同桁架。
zh.description: 中銀大廈同匯豐總行大廈重新砌過，更貼近真實，夜晚中銀嘅支撐亮成一條條光線。
zh.hero_alt: 夜晚嘅中銀大廈，交叉支撐同頂邊亮成白藍色光線。
zh.hero_caption: 夜晚嘅中銀大廈。

title: Star Ferry piers, boats and timetable
dek: Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai piers, the green-and-white boats, and the Kowloon clock tower, on a timetable that follows the sim clock.
description: The Star Ferry now has its piers at Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Wan Chai, new boats and a timetable from 06:30 to 23:30, with the clock tower beside the terminal.
hero_alt: The Tsim Sha Tsui Star Ferry pier from the harbour, with two ferries alongside and the red brick clock tower behind.
hero_caption: The Tsim Sha Tsui pier and its clock tower.
card_title: Star Ferry piers, boats and timetable
card_sub: Three piers, the clock tower and a crossing every few minutes

zh.title: 天星小輪嘅碼頭、船同時間表
zh.dek: 中環、尖沙咀同灣仔碼頭、綠白色渡輪同九龍鐘樓，班次跟模擬時鐘行。
zh.description: 天星小輪而家有中環、尖沙咀同灣仔碼頭、新嘅船同 06:30 至 23:30 嘅時間表，碼頭隔離仲有鐘樓。
zh.hero_alt: 喺海面望尖沙咀天星碼頭，兩艘渡輪泊岸，後面係紅磚鐘樓。
zh.hero_caption: 尖沙咀碼頭同佢嘅鐘樓。

title: The start button is always in view
dek: Begin descent, Take the tour and Watch the airport now stay pinned to the bottom of the home menu, bigger and brighter.
description: The home screen start button is now pinned in view, larger and brighter, so players no longer have to scroll to the bottom of the menu to find it.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak home screen with a large green Begin descent button pinned to the bottom of the menu panel.
hero_caption: The start button, pinned at the bottom of the menu.
card_title: The start button is always in view
card_sub: No more scrolling to find Begin descent

zh.title: 開始掣一直睇得到
zh.dek: 「開始下降」、「開始旅程」同「觀看機場」而家固定喺主選單底部，更大更光。
zh.description: 主畫面嘅開始掣而家固定喺畫面入面，更大更光，玩家唔使再捲到選單最底先搵到。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面，選單底部固定咗一個綠色嘅大「開始下降」掣。
zh.hero_caption: 固定喺選單底部嘅開始掣。

title: Hong Kong harbour helicopter scenic tour
dek: Ride as a passenger in the Peninsula Hotel helicopter, with a guide on screen, over Central, Shun Tak, Wan Chai and Hung Hom.
description: A new mode: ride in the window seat of the Peninsula Hotel helicopter on a four-minute scenic tour over Victoria Harbour, with captions in English and Cantonese.
hero_alt: From a helicopter window seat: Central on Hong Kong Island across Victoria Harbour, with a guide caption at the bottom of the screen.
hero_caption: Approaching Central from the passenger seat.
card_title: Hong Kong harbour helicopter scenic tour
card_sub: Ride as a passenger over Victoria Harbour

zh.title: 香港維港直升機觀光之旅
zh.dek: 以乘客身份坐半島酒店嘅直升機，有畫面導賞字幕，飛越中環、信德、灣仔同紅磡。
zh.description: 新模式：坐喺半島酒店直升機嘅窗口位，喺維多利亞港上空飛四分鐘觀光之旅，有中英文導賞字幕。
zh.hero_alt: 喺直升機窗口位望出去：維港對岸嘅港島中環，畫面底部有導賞字幕。
zh.hero_caption: 喺乘客座位望住接近中環。

title: Helicopters over Hong Kong, 1998
dek: The Government Flying Service at Kai Tak, the Macau shuttle from Shun Tak and a hotel helicopter on the Peninsula roof now fly in the sim.
description: Helicopters join the sim: GFS S-70 and S-76 from Kai Tak's south apron, the Macau shuttle from Shun Tak and a Peninsula Hotel rooftop helipad.
hero_alt: Red helicopters on the two helipads of the Kai Tak south apron, beside the flight services building.
hero_caption: The Government Flying Service pads on the Kai Tak south apron.
card_sub: GFS, the Macau shuttle and a hotel rooftop pad

zh.title: 1998 年香港上空嘅直升機
zh.dek: 啟德嘅政府飛行服務隊、信德中心往澳門嘅穿梭直升機，同半島酒店天台嘅直升機，而家都喺模擬器入面飛。
zh.description: 直升機加入模擬器：啟德南停機坪嘅政府飛行服務隊 S-70 同 S-76、信德往澳門穿梭機，同半島酒店天台直升機坪。
zh.hero_alt: 啟德南停機坪兩個直升機坪上嘅紅色直升機，旁邊係飛行服務大樓。
zh.hero_caption: 啟德南停機坪上嘅政府飛行服務隊直升機坪。

title: Kowloon Walled City, rebuilt from photographs
dek: The Walled City is now one packed block of interlocking buildings, with balconies, aerials, rooftop shacks, shop signs and lit windows at night.
description: Kowloon Walled City is rebuilt as one solid mass of 10 to 14 storey blocks with balconies, aerials, rooftop shacks, shop signs and tube-lit windows at night.
hero_alt: Kowloon Walled City from above: a dense block of grey and green buildings with a ragged roofline, surrounded by roads and taller apartment towers.
hero_caption: The Walled City from the turn onto final over Kowloon City.
card_sub: One packed block, with signs, aerials and lit windows

zh.title: 照相重砌嘅九龍寨城
zh.dek: 寨城而家係一大舊互相扣埋嘅樓，有露台、天線、天台棚屋、招牌，夜晚窗戶亮燈。
zh.description: 九龍寨城重砌成一大舊 10 至 14 層嘅樓，有露台、天線、天台棚屋、招牌，夜晚窗戶亮起光管燈。
zh.hero_alt: 喺高空望九龍寨城：一大舊灰色同綠色嘅樓，屋頂線參差不齊，四周係道路同較高嘅住宅大廈。
zh.hero_caption: 轉入最後進場、喺九龍城上面望到嘅寨城。

title: Terminal gate blocks, the nullah and the tank farm
dek: The terminal now has gate blocks sticking out from its apron face, the storm-water nullah crosses the apron under taxi bridges, and the fuel tanks sit where the photos show them.
description: Kai Tak's terminal gets protruding gate blocks for its jet bridges, the nullah crosses the apron under three taxi bridges, and the tank farm moves.
hero_alt: Kai Tak from above the Kowloon City side: the terminal with gate blocks on its apron face, the tank farm at its far end, and a channel crossing the apron.
hero_caption: The terminal, the tank farm and the nullah from over Kowloon City.
card_sub: The terminal, the apron channel and the tank farm redrawn

zh.title: 登機閘口大樓、明渠同油缸區
zh.dek: 客運大樓停機坪嗰面而家有凸出嘅閘口大樓，雨水明渠喺滑行橋底下橫過停機坪，油缸亦搬返去相入面嘅位置。
zh.description: 啟德客運大樓多咗凸出嘅登機閘口大樓，明渠喺三條滑行橋底下橫過停機坪，油缸區亦搬咗位。
zh.hero_alt: 喺九龍城上空望啟德：客運大樓停機坪嗰面有閘口大樓凸出，盡頭係油缸區，一條明渠橫過停機坪。
zh.hero_caption: 喺九龍城上空望客運大樓、油缸區同明渠。

title: The real road network, as it was in 1998
dek: Traffic now drives the Transport Department's surveyed road centrelines, with every road built after 1998 taken out.
description: Fly Kai Tak's traffic now uses Hong Kong's official road network, with Route 8, the Hung Hom Bypass, Kai Tak and other post-1998 roads removed.
hero_alt: Looking south-west over Yau Ma Tei at the bare West Kowloon reclamation, with the expressway along its edge and Hong Kong Island across the harbour.
hero_caption: West Kowloon in 1998: an empty reclamation and one new expressway.

zh.title: 1998 年真實嘅路網
zh.dek: 而家啲車行運輸署實測嘅道路中線，1998 年之後先起嘅路全部拎走。
zh.description: 飛啟德嘅交通而家用香港官方路網，8 號幹線、紅磡繞道、啟德同其他 1998 年後嘅路已經拎走。
zh.hero_alt: 喺油麻地上空向西南望，西九龍填海區仲係一片空地，快速公路沿住邊行，海港對面係香港島。
zh.hero_caption: 1998 年嘅西九龍：一片空嘅填海區同一條新快速公路。

title: The Regal Kai Tak Hotel, rebuilt from photos
dek: The airport hotel across Prince Edward Road East now has its real L-shaped plan, glass bands, brick ends, podium terrace and name.
description: The Regal Kai Tak Hotel rebuilt from photos and its roof plan: the L-shaped tower, glass bands, brick end walls, podium terrace, name signs and night lights.
hero_alt: A long dark hotel slab of glass and brown bands on a brick podium, its brick end wall carrying vertical Chinese characters, a footbridge leaving over the road.
hero_caption: The Regal Kai Tak Hotel from over the car park.
card_sub: Rebuilt from photos and the roof plan

zh.title: 富豪啟德酒店：根據相片重建
zh.dek: 太子道東對面嘅機場酒店而家有真實嘅 L 形平面、玻璃橫帶、磚砌端牆、平台露台同酒店名。
zh.description: 根據相片同天台平面圖重建富豪啟德酒店：L 形主樓、玻璃橫帶、磚砌端牆、平台露台、招牌同夜燈。
zh.hero_alt: 一座長形深色酒店，玻璃同啡色橫帶相間，企喺磚砌平台上，磚牆端面直寫中文字，行人天橋過馬路。
zh.hero_caption: 喺停車場上面望富豪啟德酒店。

title: The Big Buddha at Ngong Ping
dek: The 34 m bronze Tian Tan Buddha on its three-tier altar, Po Lin Monastery below, and new terrain carrying Lantau on to the west.
description: The Tian Tan Buddha at Ngong Ping arrives: the bronze statue, its altar, steps and Po Lin Monastery, floodlit at night, on newly extended Lantau terrain.
hero_alt: A seated bronze Buddha on a lotus throne atop a white three-tier round altar on a green hilltop, with a long flight of steps leading down.
hero_caption: The Big Buddha facing north from Mok Yu Shan, Lantau.

zh.title: 昂坪天壇大佛
zh.dek: 34 米高嘅天壇大佛連三層祭壇、山下嘅寶蓮寺，仲有向西延伸嘅大嶼山新地形。
zh.description: 昂坪天壇大佛登場：銅佛、祭壇、樓梯同寶蓮寺，夜晚有射燈，坐喺新延伸嘅大嶼山地形上。
zh.hero_alt: 一尊銅佛坐喺蓮花座上，下面係白色三層圓形祭壇，喺綠色山頂上，前面有一條長長嘅樓梯落山。
zh.hero_caption: 大嶼山木魚山上面向北方嘅大佛。

title: Kwai Chung container terminals come to life
dek: More ships alongside, more detailed quay cranes, terminal buildings, reefer racks, empties depots, yard tractors and lighters working cargo mid-stream.
description: The Kwai Chung container terminals get more ships, detailed quay cranes, offices, truck gates, freight stations, depots, yard traffic and working lighters.
hero_alt: White quay cranes working container ships along a quay, with stacked yards and rubber-tyred gantries behind.
hero_caption: Quay cranes working ships at the Kwai Chung container terminals.

zh.title: 葵涌貨櫃碼頭活起嚟
zh.dek: 更多船泊岸、更精細嘅岸邊吊機、碼頭大樓、雪櫃架、吉櫃場、碼頭拖頭，仲有躉船喺海上裝卸貨。
zh.description: 葵涌貨櫃碼頭加咗更多船、精細嘅岸邊吊機、辦公大樓、貨車閘口、貨運站、吉櫃場、堆場交通同開工嘅躉船。
zh.hero_alt: 白色岸邊吊機沿碼頭為貨櫃船裝卸，後面係貨櫃堆場同輪胎式龍門吊。
zh.hero_caption: 葵涌貨櫃碼頭嘅岸邊吊機為船裝卸。

title: Apron mast lights off on clear days
dek: The red floodlight masts now stay dark on a clear day and light up at night, in overcast weather and in fog.
description: The apron floodlight masts' lamps and obstruction lights now switch off on clear days and come on at night, in overcast weather and in fog.
hero_alt: Red floodlight masts by the remote stands on a clear day, their lamps unlit.
hero_caption: On a clear day the masts stand dark.
card_sub: On at night, in cloud and fog

zh.title: 晴天停機坪燈柱唔著燈
zh.dek: 紅色射燈柱而家晴天唔著燈，夜晚、天陰同有霧先會著。
zh.description: 停機坪射燈柱嘅射燈同障礙燈而家晴天會熄，夜晚、天陰同有霧時先著。
zh.hero_alt: 晴天時遠端停機位旁邊嘅紅色射燈柱，燈冇著。
zh.hero_caption: 晴天時燈柱唔著燈。

title: Red floodlight masts over the stands
dek: Kai Tak's tall red apron floodlight masts now stand between the parked aircraft on every row of stands, lit at night.
description: Tall red floodlight masts now stand between the stands across the Kai Tak apron, as in 1998 photos, with lamps and obstruction lights at night.
hero_alt: Red floodlight masts with lamp frames standing past the noses of aircraft parked on the remote stands at Kai Tak.
hero_caption: The red floodlight masts by the remote stands.
card_sub: Between the stands, lit at night

zh.title: 停機位上嘅紅色射燈柱
zh.dek: 啟德停機坪又高又紅嘅射燈柱，而家企喺每排停機位嘅飛機之間，夜晚會著燈。
zh.description: 啟德停機坪而家有又高又紅嘅射燈柱企喺停機位之間，同 1998 年舊相一樣，夜晚有射燈同障礙燈。
zh.hero_alt: 紅色射燈柱連燈架，企喺啟德遠端停機位飛機機頭前面。
zh.hero_caption: 遠端停機位旁邊嘅紅色射燈柱。

title: The car park moves to the runway end, with the airport hotel and its footbridge
dek: The car park now stands where the aerial photos show it, and the airport hotel stands across Prince Edward Road East, joined by its cable-stayed footbridge.
description: The Kai Tak car park moves to the runway end of the terminal frontage, with the airport hotel across Prince Edward Road East and its footbridge.
hero_alt: An aerial view of the car park along the runway end of the terminal, with the airport hotel across the road.
hero_caption: The car park and the airport hotel, from over Kowloon City.

zh.title: 停車場搬到跑道嗰頭，加埋機場酒店同行人天橋
zh.dek: 停車場而家企喺航拍相顯示嘅位置，太子道東對面係機場酒店，用斜拉式行人天橋連接。
zh.description: 啟德停車場搬到客運大樓前面近跑道嗰頭，太子道東對面加咗機場酒店同佢嘅行人天橋。
zh.hero_alt: 鳥瞰沿客運大樓近跑道嗰頭嘅停車場，同馬路對面嘅機場酒店。
zh.hero_caption: 由九龍城上空望停車場同機場酒店。

title: The car park roof view moves to the new car park
dek: The Plane Spotter car park view now stands at the rail of the new landside car park, looking over the terminal to the runway.
description: The Car park roof spotter view now sits on the new landside car park, at the runway-end rail, with a clear view over the terminal.
hero_alt: The view from the car park roof rail over the terminal roof to the apron, the runway and the harbour.
hero_caption: The Car park roof view from its new spot.

zh.title: 停車場天台視角搬到新停車場
zh.dek: 「觀機」嘅停車場視角而家企喺陸側新停車場嘅欄河邊，望過客運大樓睇跑道。
zh.description: 「停車場天台」觀機視角而家喺陸側新停車場跑道嗰頭嘅欄河邊，望過客運大樓冇遮擋。
zh.hero_alt: 由停車場天台欄河望過客運大樓天台，見到停機坪、跑道同海港。
zh.hero_caption: 新位置嘅停車場天台視角。

title: 13 more parking bays from the Kai Tak plan
dek: Stands 21 to 26 between lanes D3 and D2, a new east apron with stands 51 to 57, and the south apron parked nose-in.
description: Checked against an unofficial Kai Tak plan: new stands 21-26, an east apron with stands 51-57, and south apron stands 71-81 now nose-in.
hero_alt: Stands 21 to 26 between apron lanes D3 and D2, with red stand boxes, yellow lead-in lines, numbered plates and parked airliners.
hero_caption: The new stands 21 to 26, between lanes D3 and D2.
card_sub: Stands 21-26 and a new east apron

zh.title: 啟德平面圖多咗 13 個停機位
zh.dek: D3 同 D2 之間嘅 21 至 26 號停機位、新東停機坪 51 至 57 號，南停機坪改為機頭向內。
zh.description: 對照非官方啟德平面圖：新增 21 至 26 號停機位、東停機坪 51 至 57 號，南停機坪 71 至 81 號改為機頭向內。
zh.hero_alt: D3 同 D2 滑行道之間嘅 21 至 26 號停機位，有紅色停機框、黃色引導線、編號牌同泊住嘅客機。
zh.hero_caption: D3 同 D2 之間嘅新 21 至 26 號停機位。

title: The car park moves to the landside of the terminal
dek: A long, stepped car park beside the terminal, with footbridges, the clock wall and the spotters' crowd on its roof, as in the 1990s photos.
description: The Kai Tak car park now runs along the landside of the terminal, with footbridges, the clock and airport sign on its end wall and spotters on the roof.
hero_alt: The end wall of the car park with a large clock and the Kai Tak airport sign, spotters lining the roof above it.
hero_caption: The car park's clock wall, with the spotters on the roof.

zh.title: 停車場搬到客運大樓陸側
zh.dek: 一座分兩級嘅長條形停車場，喺客運大樓旁邊，有行人天橋、大鐘外牆，天台企滿觀機人群，同九十年代舊相一樣。
zh.description: 啟德停車場而家沿住客運大樓陸側伸延，有行人天橋，盡頭外牆掛住大鐘同機場招牌，天台企滿觀機人士。
zh.hero_alt: 停車場盡頭外牆有個大鐘同啟德機場招牌，上面天台企滿觀機人士。
zh.hero_caption: 停車場嘅大鐘外牆，天台上企滿觀機嘅人。

title: The Kai Tak shop is open
dek: Tees, a cap, a patch, a pin, a poster, a mug and stickers, all from the checkerboard and the IGS 13 approach. Linked from the home screen.
description: Fly Kai Tak has a merch shop: checkerboard and IGS 13 tees, a Runway 13 cap, a 1998 patch, a pin, a poster, a mug and stickers.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak shop page, titled The Kai Tak shop, with 啟德 in large characters and the first products below.
hero_caption: The Kai Tak shop at flykaitak.com/shop.

zh.title: 啟德商店開張
zh.dek: T 恤、帽、布章、襟章、海報、杯同貼紙，全部來自棋盤同 IGS 13 進場。主畫面有連結。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 開咗精品商店：棋盤同 IGS 13 T 恤、13 號跑道帽、1998 布章、襟章、海報、杯同貼紙。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 商店頁面，標題係啟德商店，大字寫住「啟德」，下面係第一批貨品。
zh.hero_caption: flykaitak.com/shop 嘅啟德商店。

title: Boats along the seawall, not in the inlet
dek: Harbour craft come right up to the runway seawall again, but keep out of the inlet under the south apron taxiways.
description: Boats pass right alongside Kai Tak's runway seawall again, as in the 1990s, but never enter the inlet under the taxiways to the south apron.
hero_alt: The water inlet between the runway-side taxiway and the south apron, empty, with boats out in the harbour beyond.
hero_caption: The inlet to the south apron stays clear.
card_sub: None in the south apron inlet

zh.title: 船沿海堤行，唔入水道
zh.dek: 海港嘅船又可以駛到跑道海堤旁邊，但唔會入南停機坪滑行道下面嘅水道。
zh.description: 船又再沿住啟德跑道海堤經過，好似九十年代咁，但唔會駛入通去南停機坪嘅滑行道下面嘅水道。
zh.hero_alt: 跑道側滑行道同南停機坪之間嘅水道，冇船，遠處海港有船。
zh.hero_caption: 通去南停機坪嘅水道保持冇船。

title: Wider spacing between taxiing aircraft
dek: Ground control now keeps taxiing jets twice as far apart, except in the queue for take-off.
description: Taxiing aircraft at Kai Tak now keep double the gap on the taxiways. Departures queuing at the runway end can still close up.
hero_alt: Two airliners taxiing along taxiway A beside the Runway 13 threshold, well apart, with the terminal stands behind.
hero_caption: Two jets on taxiway A, holding the wider gap.
card_sub: Double the gap on the taxiways

zh.title: 滑行飛機之間距離加闊
zh.dek: 地面管制而家令滑行中嘅飛機相距多一倍，排隊起飛除外。
zh.description: 啟德滑行中嘅飛機而家喺滑行道上面保持雙倍距離，喺跑道尾排隊起飛嘅仍然可以貼近。
zh.hero_alt: 兩架客機喺 13 號跑道入口旁邊嘅 A 滑行道上面滑行，距離拉得好開，後面係客運大樓停機位。
zh.hero_caption: 兩架飛機喺 A 滑行道，保持較闊嘅距離。

title: The checkerboard turn tightens at the end
dek: A gentle bank past the checkerboard, then about 25° for the last few seconds before roll-out, as pilots flew it.
description: Kai Tak's checkerboard turn now starts gently and tightens to about 25° of bank over Kowloon City before rolling out on the runway.
hero_alt: A 747 in a steep right bank low over Kowloon City, with the runway just ahead.
hero_caption: The steep end of the checkerboard turn.
card_sub: About 25° of bank at the end

zh.title: 格仔山轉彎尾段收緊
zh.dek: 經過格仔山時輕輕傾側，對正跑道前幾秒加到約 25°，同機師當年飛法一樣。
zh.description: 啟德格仔山轉彎而家由輕微傾側開始，喺九龍城上空收緊到約 25°，然後對正跑道。
zh.hero_alt: 一架 747 喺九龍城上空大角度右傾，跑道就喺前面。
zh.hero_caption: 格仔山轉彎最急嗰段。

title: Maintenance apron now matches the flight apron
dek: The dark pavement in front of the hangars is now the same concrete as the rest of the flight apron.
description: The Kai Tak maintenance apron in front of the hangars now uses the same concrete colour as the main flight apron, with no dark patch or seam.
hero_alt: The maintenance area on pale concrete that runs on from the main apron.
hero_caption: The maintenance apron on the same concrete as the flight apron.

zh.title: 維修停機坪同主停機坪一樣色
zh.dek: 機庫前面嘅深色路面，而家同其他停機坪用同一種混凝土。
zh.description: 啟德機庫前面嘅維修停機坪而家用同主停機坪一樣嘅混凝土顏色，冇咗深色路面同接縫。
zh.hero_alt: 維修區嘅淺色混凝土同主停機坪連成一片。
zh.hero_caption: 維修停機坪用同主停機坪一樣嘅混凝土。

title: The checkerboard turn now starts at 650 ft, 2 NM out
dek: A wider, higher right turn that matches how Kai Tak's IGS 13 approach was flown, plus an aviation-orange checkerboard.
description: Kai Tak's checkerboard turn now starts about 2 NM out at 650 ft and rolls out near 140 ft, with an orange-and-white checkerboard.
hero_alt: A 747 halfway through the checkerboard turn, with the orange-and-white checkerboard on the hill to the left.
hero_caption: Halfway round the wider checkerboard turn.
card_sub: In at 650 ft, out at 140 ft

zh.title: 格仔山轉彎而家喺 2 海里外、650 呎開始
zh.dek: 轉彎闊咗、高咗，同啟德 IGS 13 進場真實飛法一樣，格仔山都變返航空橙色。
zh.description: 啟德格仔山轉彎而家喺約 2 海里外、650 呎開始，約 140 呎對正跑道，格仔山改做橙白色。
zh.hero_alt: 一架 747 轉到一半，左邊山上有橙白格仔。
zh.hero_caption: 轉到一半嘅格仔山彎。

title: One bridge, a joined-up apron and a wider taxiway
dek: The flight apron now runs on into the south apron, a single bridge crosses the inlet, and the taxiway tarmac widens toward the 31 end.
description: Kai Tak's apron now runs into the south apron, one bridge crosses the inlet, and the taxiway tarmac widens near the Runway 31 end.
hero_alt: Kai Tak from above: the main apron running on into the south apron, with the inlet beside the runway.
hero_caption: The main apron now runs on into the south apron.

zh.title: 一條橋、連埋嘅停機坪同闊咗嘅滑行道
zh.dek: 停機坪而家直接連到南停機坪，水道上面得一條橋，近31號跑道嗰頭嘅滑行道停機坪闊咗。
zh.description: 啟德停機坪而家連到南停機坪，水道上淨係一條橋，近31號跑道嘅滑行道停機坪闊咗。
zh.hero_alt: 從高空睇啟德：主停機坪一路連到南停機坪，跑道旁邊有水道。
zh.hero_caption: 主停機坪而家直接連到南停機坪。

title: The control tower is back on the terminal roof
dek: Kai Tak's control tower now stands on the passenger terminal at its runway end, where it really was, with its outward-leaning cab windows.
description: The Kai Tak control tower moves to its real spot on the terminal roof at the runway end, rebuilt from period photos with outward-leaning glass.
hero_alt: The control tower on the terminal roof, with outward-leaning cab windows.
hero_caption: The rebuilt tower on the terminal roof.
card_sub: Its real spot, with leaning glass

zh.title: 控制塔返到客運大樓天台
zh.dek: 啟德控制塔而家企喺客運大樓天台近跑道嗰頭，即係佢真正嘅位置，仲有向外斜嘅控制室玻璃。
zh.description: 啟德控制塔搬返去客運大樓天台嘅真實位置，跟舊相重建，控制室玻璃向外斜。
zh.hero_alt: 客運大樓天台上嘅控制塔，控制室窗向外斜。
zh.hero_caption: 重建後喺大樓天台嘅控制塔。

title: Follow Fly Kai Tak on Facebook and Instagram
dek: Fly Kai Tak now has a Facebook page and an Instagram account, linked from the home screen and the blog footer.
description: Follow Fly Kai Tak on Facebook and Instagram at @flykaitak. Both are now linked from the home screen and every blog page.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak home screen with Follow Fly Kai Tak links to Facebook and Instagram.
hero_caption: Follow links on the home screen.

zh.title: 喺 Facebook 同 Instagram 追蹤 Fly Kai Tak
zh.dek: Fly Kai Tak 而家有 Facebook 專頁同 Instagram 帳戶，主畫面同網誌頁底都有連結。
zh.description: 喺 Facebook 同 Instagram 追蹤 Fly Kai Tak（@flykaitak），主畫面同每個網誌頁都有連結。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面，有去 Facebook 同 Instagram 嘅追蹤連結。
zh.hero_caption: 主畫面嘅追蹤連結。

title: Harbour shipping follows the fairways
dek: Ships now sail one way along the charted fairways, keeping right, and most of the harbour's vessels are moored or at anchor.
description: Moving ships follow the Marine Department fairways and traffic separation schemes, one way and keeping right, while most harbour vessels lie moored or at anchor.
hero_alt: Cargo ships under way in Victoria Harbour with wakes behind them.
hero_caption: Through traffic in Victoria Harbour.

zh.title: 港內船隻跟返航道
zh.dek: 船隻而家沿海圖航道單向靠右行，港內大部分船都係停泊或者拋錨。
zh.description: 行緊嘅船跟海事處航道同分道航行制單向靠右行，港內大部分船就停泊或者拋錨。
zh.hero_alt: 維多利亞港內行緊嘅貨船，船尾拖住尾浪。
zh.hero_caption: 維多利亞港嘅過境船隻。

title: Separate menus for flight, spotter and terminal views
dek: The camera menu is split into Flight views, Plane spotter and Terminal interior.
description: Kai Tak's camera menu is now three: Flight views, Plane spotter spots and a new Terminal interior menu for the hall, immigration, arcade, gate lounge, stairs and entrance.
hero_alt: The top bar with three view menus while the camera stands in the departures hall.
hero_caption: Flight views, Plane spotter and Terminal interior.

zh.title: 飛行、觀機同客運大樓視角分開選單
zh.dek: 鏡頭選單分咗做飛行視角、觀機位置同客運大樓內部三個。
zh.description: 啟德嘅鏡頭選單而家有三個：飛行視角、觀機位置，同新嘅客運大樓內部選單，包括大堂、入境檢查、商店街、候機室、樓梯同正門。
zh.hero_alt: 頂部列有三個視角選單，鏡頭企喺離境大堂入面。
zh.hero_caption: 飛行視角、觀機位置同客運大樓內部。

title: South apron, helipads and inlet taxiways
dek: Stands 71 to 81, two helipads, taxiway bridges over the water inlet, fuel tanks by the terminal and bitumen at the hangars.
description: Kai Tak's south apron with stands 71-81, helipads and taxiway bridges over the inlet, plus fuel tanks beside the terminal and bitumen at the maintenance hangars.
hero_alt: A long south apron with parked aircraft beside the water inlet, two taxiway bridges and two helipads.
hero_caption: The south apron across the inlet.

zh.title: 南停機坪、直升機坪同海灣滑行道
zh.dek: 71至81號機位、兩個直升機坪、海灣上嘅滑行道橋、大樓旁嘅油缸同機庫嘅瀝青路面。
zh.description: 啟德南停機坪有71至81號機位、直升機坪同橫過海灣嘅滑行道橋，仲有客運大樓旁嘅油缸同維修機庫嘅瀝青路面。
zh.hero_alt: 海灣旁邊停咗飛機嘅南停機坪、兩條滑行道橋同兩個直升機坪。
zh.hero_caption: 隔住海灣望南停機坪。

title: Inside the 1998 terminal: staff and signs
dek: Walk into Kai Tak's terminal: yellow bilingual signs, red check-in desks, immigration, shops and security staff in blue.
description: The Kai Tak terminal now has a 1998 interior: check-in desks, departure immigration, a shop arcade, arrivals, signs and staff including armed security.
hero_alt: The departures hall with red check-in desks, flight boards and passengers.
hero_caption: The departures hall on the 1/F.

zh.title: 1998年客運大樓內部：職員同指示牌
zh.dek: 行入啟德客運大樓：黃色中英指示牌、紅色登機櫃台、入境處、商店同藍色制服保安。
zh.description: 啟德客運大樓而家有1998年內部：登機櫃台、離境入境、商店街、抵港大堂、指示牌同職員，包括帶槍保安。
zh.hero_alt: 離境大堂，紅色登機櫃台、航班板同乘客。
zh.hero_caption: 1/F離境大堂。

title: Maintenance area moved to the chart position
dek: The hangars, tower, compound and tank farm now sit where the 1996 chart and airport plan put them, at the chart's angle.
description: The Kai Tak maintenance area is repositioned to match the 1996 parking chart and airport plan: hangars, workshop tower, compound and offices turned to the chart angle.
hero_alt: Three hangars with open door bays beside a fenced compound.
hero_caption: The hangars in their new position.

zh.title: 維修區移到圖表位置
zh.dek: 機庫、工場塔、維修區同油缸區而家企喺1996年圖表同機場平面圖所示嘅位置，角度亦跟圖表。
zh.description: 啟德維修區按1996年停機坪圖同機場平面圖重新定位：機庫、工場塔、維修區同辦公樓轉到圖表角度。
zh.hero_alt: 有圍欄維修區隔離嘅三個開門機庫。
zh.hero_caption: 機庫喺新位置。

title: Maintenance area: hangars and tank farm
dek: The maintenance area is rebuilt from the chart and photos: three hangars with lit bays, a workshop tower, a fenced aircraft compound and a tank farm.
description: Kai Tak's maintenance area now has three hangars with lit bays, a workshop tower, a fenced aircraft compound, a blast fence, floodlights and a fuel tank farm.
hero_alt: Three hangars with skylight roofs and open door bays beyond a fenced compound with a stripped 747.
hero_caption: The maintenance area from the apron side.

zh.title: 維修區：機庫同油缸區
zh.dek: 維修區根據圖表同相片重建：三個亮燈機庫、工場塔、有圍欄嘅飛機維修區同油缸區。
zh.description: 啟德維修區而家有三個亮燈機庫、工場塔、有圍欄嘅飛機維修區、擋噴氣牆、泛光燈同油缸區。
zh.hero_alt: 有圍欄嘅拆機區後面，三個有天窗天台同開咗門嘅機庫。
zh.hero_caption: 由停機坪嗰邊望維修區。

title: Remote stands and apron buses
dek: Aircraft now park on the remote stands without jet bridges, and apron buses carry the passengers.
description: Remote stands 11 to 19 at Kai Tak hold parked aircraft, and apron buses run from a new bus gate to their doors when no jet bridge is free.
hero_alt: Aircraft parked nose-in on the remote stands along apron lane D2.
hero_caption: Aircraft parked on the remote stands along lane D2.

zh.title: 遠端機位同機場巴士
zh.dek: 飛機而家停喺冇登機橋嘅遠端機位，機場巴士負責接載乘客。
zh.description: 啟德 11 至 19 號遠端機位停咗飛機，冇登機橋可用嗰陣，機場巴士會由新嘅巴士閘口駛去機門。
zh.hero_alt: 飛機機頭向內停喺 D2 滑行道旁邊嘅遠端機位。
zh.hero_caption: D2 滑行道旁邊遠端機位上嘅飛機。

title: Cargo terminal and freighters
dek: A cargo terminal, two freighter types and their handling vehicles now work alongside the passenger flights.
description: Kai Tak gets a cargo terminal with stands 41 to 46, 747-400F and A300-600F freighters in the schedule, cargo loaders and trucks, plus new hangars and car park detail.
hero_alt: Six freighters nose-in to the maroon cargo terminal, stands 41 to 46.
hero_caption: Stands 41 to 46 along the cargo terminal.

zh.title: 貨運大樓同貨機
zh.dek: 貨運大樓、兩款貨機同地勤車輛，而家同客運航班一齊運作。
zh.description: 啟德加入貨運大樓同 41 至 46 號機位、時間表有 747-400F 同 A300-600F 貨機、貨運裝載車同貨車，仲有新機庫同停車場細節。
zh.hero_alt: 六架貨機機頭向住棗紅色貨運大樓，41 至 46 號機位。
zh.hero_caption: 貨運大樓旁邊嘅 41 至 46 號機位。

title: Real Housing Authority estates
dek: The 1998 public housing estates now come from the Housing Authority's list, each built from its real block types.
description: Public housing estates now use the Housing Authority's estate list: the 101 estates from 1998 inside the map, each rebuilt from its real block types and heights.
hero_alt: Wang Tau Hom Estate: cross-plan towers in blue and orange standing together on the hillside, with lift motor rooms and water tanks on the roofs.
hero_caption: Wang Tau Hom Estate: cross-plan towers in two pastel shades, each with a roof machine room and water tank.

zh.title: 真實房屋署屋邨
zh.dek: 1998 年嘅公共屋邨而家用房屋署清單，按真實大廈類型來起。
zh.description: 公共屋邨而家用房屋署嘅屋邨清單：地圖內 101 個 1998 年已入伙嘅屋邨，各按真實大廈類型同高度重建。
zh.hero_alt: 橫頭磡邨：藍色同橙色嘅十字形大廈企喺山坡，天台有機房同水缸。
zh.hero_caption: 橫頭磡邨：兩種粉彩色嘅十字形大廈，天台都有機房同水缸。

title: Public housing estates in bunches
dek: Cross, Y, twin-tower and slab blocks now stand in matching groups, with pastel facades and rooftop tanks.
description: Hong Kong public housing blocks (Harmony, Trident, Twin Tower and slab) now stand in matching estates in the sim, with pastel facades, air-conditioners and roof tanks.
hero_alt: A bunch of tall cross-shaped housing blocks with lift motor rooms and water tanks on their roofs, on a hillside above the harbour.
hero_caption: A bunch of cross-plan blocks, each with a lift motor room and a water tank on the roof.

zh.title: 公共屋邨成群出現
zh.dek: 十字形、Y 形、雙塔同長條形大廈而家成組出現，有粉彩外牆同天台水缸。
zh.description: 模擬器入面嘅公共屋邨大廈（和諧式、三叉型、雙塔式同長條型）而家成組出現，有粉彩外牆、冷氣機同天台水缸。
zh.hero_alt: 一群十字形高層屋邨大廈，天台有升降機機房同水缸，喺維港上面嘅山坡。
zh.hero_caption: 一群十字形大廈，每幢天台都有升降機機房同水缸。

title: Share buttons on the home screen
dek: Send Fly Kai Tak to a friend from the home screen: X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp, Threads, email or a copied link.
description: The home screen now has share buttons for X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp, Threads, email, copy link and the system share sheet, in English or Cantonese.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak home screen with a row of share buttons under the demo reel and the Buy me a coffee button.
hero_caption: The share row under the demo reel, next to the coffee button.
card_title: Share buttons on the home screen

zh.title: 主畫面加咗分享掣
zh.dek: 喺主畫面就可以將 Fly Kai Tak 介紹畀朋友：X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp、Threads、電郵或者複製連結。
zh.description: 主畫面而家有分享掣：X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp、Threads、電郵、複製連結同系統分享選單，支援英文同廣東話。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面，示範短片同「請我飲杯咖啡」掣下面有一排分享掣。
zh.hero_caption: 示範短片下面嘅分享掣，喺咖啡掣隔離。

title: Bay lines on the car park roof
dek: White parking bay lines now mark out rows of 5 m by 2.5 m bays on the Plane Spotter roof.
description: The Plane Spotter car park roof now has white parking bay lines: a row against the far wall and three double rows with aisles between them.
hero_alt: White parking bay lines in rows across the car park roof, with globe lamps and the apron beyond.
hero_caption: The bay rows on the roof, with the globe lamps and the apron beyond.

zh.title: 停車場天台加咗停車位線
zh.dek: 「飛機觀察」天台而家有白色停車位線，每個車位 5 米乘 2.5 米。
zh.description: 「飛機觀察」嘅停車場天台而家有白色停車位線：遠邊牆腳一排，加三組雙排車位，中間有車道。
zh.hero_alt: 停車場天台上一排排白色停車位線，後面有圓球燈同停機坪。
zh.hero_caption: 天台上嘅停車位線，後面係圓球燈同停機坪。

title: More detail on the car park roof
dek: Globe lamps, a pipe railing along the parapet and a stairwell head with its exit and caution signs.
description: The Plane Spotter car park roof now has globe lamps, a pipe railing and crowd barrier, a painted deck and a stairwell entry with exit and caution signs.
hero_alt: The car park roof at night with glowing white globe lamps and a pipe railing along the parapet.
hero_caption: The car park roof after dark, with the globe lamps lit.

zh.title: 停車場天台加咗好多細節
zh.dek: 圓球燈、欄河鋼管扶手，仲有樓梯間同埋出口、小心標誌牌。
zh.description: 「飛機觀察」嘅停車場天台而家有圓球燈、鋼管扶手同人群欄障、畫好線嘅地面，仲有掛住出口同小心牌嘅樓梯間入口。
zh.hero_alt: 夜晚嘅停車場天台，發光嘅白色圓球燈同欄河上嘅鋼管扶手。
zh.hero_caption: 天黑之後嘅停車場天台，圓球燈全部亮晒。

title: FAA signs and markings on the airfield
dek: Runway holding positions, taxiway lines, distance-remaining boards and the red, yellow and black signs, all from the FAA Aeronautical Information Manual.
description: Fly Kai Tak now has FAA-style airfield signs and markings: touchdown-zone bars, hold lines, link taxiways B1 to B6, and mandatory, location, direction and distance signs.
hero_alt: Link taxiway B1 meeting the runway, with a red 13-31 holding sign, a yellow B1 direction sign and yellow lines across the taxiway.
hero_caption: B1 at the runway: red holding signs, a yellow direction sign and the four-line holding position.
card_sub: Hold lines, B1 to B6, distance boards

zh.title: 機場加咗 FAA 標誌同標記
zh.dek: 跑道等候位置、滑行道線、剩餘距離牌，仲有紅、黃、黑三色標誌牌，全部跟 FAA《航空資訊手冊》。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 而家有 FAA 款機場標誌同標記：接地區標記、等候線、B1 至 B6 連接滑行道，仲有強制、位置、方向同距離標誌牌。
zh.hero_alt: B1 連接滑行道接駁跑道：紅色 13-31 等候牌、黃色 B1 方向牌，同橫過滑行道嘅黃線。
zh.hero_caption: B1 接跑道處：紅色等候牌、黃色方向牌同四線等候位置。

title: Fix: Aircraft Stay on the Tarmac
dek: Taxiing aircraft use the link taxiways and never cross the grass.
description: Fly Kai Tak ground fix: arrivals leave the runway by a link taxiway, every aircraft keeps its wheels on the tarmac, and the grass is off limits.
hero_alt: A 747 turning off Runway 13 onto a link taxiway, with taxiway A and the green grass on either side.
hero_caption: A Runway 13 arrival leaves the runway by the link taxiway instead of cutting across the grass.

zh.title: 修正：飛機只喺柏油路面行駛
zh.dek: 滑行中嘅飛機行連接滑行道，唔會再駛過草地。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 地面修正：降落飛機經連接滑行道離開跑道，所有飛機嘅機輪都喺柏油路面上，草地唔准行。
zh.hero_alt: 一架 747 由 13 跑道轉入連接滑行道，滑行道 A 同綠色草地分別喺兩邊。
zh.hero_caption: 13 跑道嘅降落飛機經連接滑行道離開跑道，唔再橫過草地。

title: The map is off until you turn it on
dek: The corner map no longer switches itself on when the home screen loads. Press M or tick the option to show it.
description: Fly Kai Tak's corner map now starts hidden on the home screen and in flights. Press M or tick Map with live aircraft under Options to show it.
hero_alt: The home screen on load with no map showing.
hero_caption: The home screen on load: no map until you press M.
card_title: Map off until you turn it on

zh.title: 地圖預設關閉，要開先自己開
zh.dek: 主畫面載入時，角落地圖唔會再自動開啟。㩒 M 鍵或者剔選項就會顯示。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅角落地圖而家喺主畫面同飛行入面預設收埋；㩒 M 鍵或者喺「選項」剔選「即時飛機地圖」就會顯示。
zh.hero_alt: 主畫面一載入，冇顯示地圖。
zh.hero_caption: 主畫面一載入：㩒 M 之前冇地圖。

title: A longer thrust bar for finer control
dek: The touch thrust bar is up to 260 px tall, so small thrust changes are easier to set.
description: Fly Kai Tak's thrust lever bar is now up to 260 px tall on desktop and 170 px on landscape phones, giving finer control of thrust.
hero_alt: The 747 on approach with the longer thrust bar at the bottom right, set at 9 percent.
hero_caption: The longer thrust bar at the bottom right, set at 9%.

zh.title: 加長推力桿，微調更準
zh.dek: 觸控推力桿最長 260 px，微調推力容易啲。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅推力桿而家喺桌面最長 260 px、手機橫向最長 170 px，微調推力更準。
zh.hero_alt: 747 進場，右下角嘅推力桿加長咗，設定喺 9%。
zh.hero_caption: 右下角加長咗嘅推力桿，設定喺 9%。

title: A bigger map on the home screen and in Plane Spotter
dek: The corner map is twice the size on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, and it steps aside when High scores is open.
description: Fly Kai Tak's corner map is now double size on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, and the home screen map moves clear of the High scores panel.
hero_alt: The home screen with High scores open and the larger map at the bottom right, clear of the panel.
hero_caption: High scores open: the map moves clear of the panel.

zh.title: 主畫面同 Plane Spotter 嘅大啲地圖
zh.dek: 主畫面同 Plane Spotter 嘅角落地圖大咗一倍，開咗 High scores 就會自動讓開。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅角落地圖喺主畫面同 Plane Spotter 而家大兩倍，主畫面嘅地圖會避開 High scores 面板。
zh.hero_alt: 主畫面開咗 High scores，放大咗嘅地圖移去右下角，冇俾面板遮住。
zh.hero_caption: 開咗 High scores，地圖移開，唔會被面板遮住。

title: Flight Board Key and Button
dek: Press B on the home screen to hide or show the flight board, or use the new Flights button.
description: Switch the Fly Kai Tak flight information board on and off with the B key on the home screen as well as in Plane Spotter, or with the new Flights button.
hero_alt: The home screen with the flight board hidden and the Flights button dimmed.
hero_caption: The home screen with the board hidden.
card_sub: B key and a Flights button

zh.title: 航班資訊板鍵同掣
zh.dek: 喺主畫面㩒 B 就可以收埋或者顯示航班資訊板，亦可以用新嘅航班掣。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅航班資訊板而家喺主畫面都可以用 B 鍵開關，同觀機模式一樣，亦多咗航班掣。
zh.hero_alt: 收埋咗航班資訊板嘅主畫面，航班掣變暗。
zh.hero_caption: 收埋資訊板嘅主畫面。

title: New: link taxiways between the runway and taxiway A
dek: Five angled bitumen strips now cross the grass between the runway and the parallel taxiway.
description: Fly Kai Tak update: five angled bitumen link taxiways now join the runway to parallel taxiway A, matching the aerial photographs of Kai Tak.
hero_alt: Looking along Runway 13 from above, with bitumen link strips crossing the grass between the runway and the parallel taxiway.
hero_caption: Link strips crossing the grass between the runway and taxiway A.
card_sub: Bitumen strips between runway and taxiway

zh.title: 新增：跑道同滑行道 A 之間嘅連接道
zh.dek: 五條斜斜嘅瀝青連接道而家橫過跑道同平行滑行道之間嘅草地。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 更新：五條斜瀝青連接道而家將跑道接去平行滑行道 A，同啟德機場航拍相一致。
zh.hero_alt: 由高處沿住 13 跑道望，有瀝青連接道橫過跑道同平行滑行道之間嘅草地。
zh.hero_caption: 橫過跑道同滑行道 A 之間草地嘅連接道。

title: Rooftop Cross-Bar Lights on the Approach
dek: Bright lamp masts on Kowloon rooftops now mark the approach to both runways.
description: Three bright cross-bar lamp masts on tall Kowloon rooftops now mark the approach to Runway 13 and Runway 31, glowing at night under the flight path.
hero_alt: A bright white column of lamps on a rooftop in Kowloon at night.
hero_caption: A cross-bar mast on a Kowloon rooftop.

zh.title: 進場航道嘅樓頂橫桿燈
zh.dek: 九龍樓頂嘅光亮燈桿而家標示兩條跑道嘅進場。
zh.description: 九龍高樓樓頂新增三支光亮橫桿燈桿，標示 13 跑道同 31 跑道嘅進場，夜晚喺航道下面發光。
zh.hero_alt: 夜晚九龍樓頂上一柱光亮嘅白燈。
zh.hero_caption: 九龍樓頂上嘅橫桿燈桿。

title: Update: starter scores on the high score table
dek: Ten fictional, easy-to-beat scores fill the table so it is never empty.
description: Fly Kai Tak update: the high score table now starts with ten fictional, easy-to-beat scores, from 58 down to 15.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak home screen with the High scores panel open, listing ten starter scores from 58 down to 15.
hero_caption: The starter table: the best fictional score is 58.

zh.title: 更新：最高分榜加入起始分數
zh.dek: 十個好易超越嘅虛構分數，令榜單唔再係空嘅。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 更新：最高分榜而家預先有十個虛構、好易超越嘅分數，由 58 分到 15 分。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面打開咗最高分面板，列出十個由 58 分到 15 分嘅起始分數。
zh.hero_caption: 起始榜單：最高嘅虛構分數係 58 分。

title: Concorde at Kai Tak: The Rare Visits
dek: A 1976 sales tour and a 1985 charter: the Concorde visits on record, with the sim's Concorde landing, taxiing and taking off.
description: Concorde's rare visits to Kai Tak: the 1976 sales tour, a 1985 charter, and how Fly Kai Tak's Concorde special lands, taxis and takes off.
hero_alt: The delta-wing jet climbing steeply over Kowloon Bay after take-off.
hero_caption: Climbing out over Kowloon Bay.

zh.title: 協和式客機喺啟德：罕見訪問
zh.dek: 1976 年推廣旅程同 1985 年包機：有記錄嘅協和式到訪，加上模擬器入面協和式降落、滑行同起飛。
zh.description: 協和式客機罕見到訪啟德：1976 年推廣旅程、1985 年包機，以及 Fly Kai Tak 協和式特別訪客點降落、滑行同起飛。
zh.hero_alt: 三角翼客機起飛後喺九龍灣上空陡爬。
zh.hero_caption: 喺九龍灣上空爬升。

title: A Concorde Visits Kai Tak
dek: A rare special for plane spotters: a supersonic delta-wing jet lands, parks at stand 6 and departs.
description: Plane Spotter gets a rare Concorde-style special: a drooped-nose delta-wing jet that lands hourly, parks at stand 6 and leaves, with its own gold board rows.
hero_alt: A slim white delta-wing jet on final approach over Kowloon with its nose drooped.
hero_caption: On final over Kowloon, nose drooped.

zh.title: 協和式客機到訪啟德
zh.dek: 觀機迷嘅罕見特別節目：超音速三角翼客機降落、泊 6 號機位，然後離開。
zh.description: 觀機模式新增罕見嘅協和式特別訪客：機鼻下垂嘅三角翼客機每小時降落、泊 6 號機位再離開，資訊板有金色特別航班。
zh.hero_alt: 一架白色修長三角翼客機喺九龍上空最後進場，機鼻向下垂。
zh.hero_caption: 喺九龍上空最後進場，機鼻下垂。

title: The map on the home screen, with M to toggle
dek: The corner map now shows as soon as the home screen loads, over the live demo, and M turns it on and off there too.
description: Fly Kai Tak's corner map now shows automatically on the home screen over the live demo flight, and the M key toggles it on and off, on the home screen and in flight.
hero_alt: The home screen with the corner map showing the demo aircraft on the IGS approach.
hero_caption: The home screen on load, with the map in the top left.
card_sub: Shows on load, M to toggle

zh.title: 主畫面嘅地圖，用 M 鍵開關
zh.dek: 主畫面一載入，角落地圖就會喺即時示範上面自動顯示，喺主畫面都可以用 M 鍵開關。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅角落地圖而家喺主畫面一載入就自動顯示，疊喺即時示範飛行上面；M 鍵可以喺主畫面同飛行入面開關。
zh.hero_alt: 主畫面，左上角嘅地圖顯示示範飛機喺 IGS 進場。
zh.hero_caption: 主畫面一載入，左上角已經有地圖。

title: New: a landing lesson for first-time pilots
dek: A guided IGS 13 approach: wheels down, flaps, speed, the checkerboard turn, the flare and the stop. No experience needed.
description: Fly Kai Tak now has a Landing lesson: a coach panel walks first-time pilots through the Runway 13 IGS approach in nine steps with live meters and plain-language tips.
hero_alt: The Landing lesson welcome panel above a 747 on the IGS approach to Kai Tak, with a Start the lesson button.
hero_caption: The lesson starts on the approach at 3,100 ft with a plain-language welcome.

zh.title: 新增：俾初學者嘅降落教學
zh.dek: 跟住 IGS 13 進場一步一步學：放起落架、襟翼、速度、棋盤轉彎、拉平同停機。唔使有經驗。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 新增降落教學：教練面板分九步帶初學者飛 13 號跑道嘅 IGS 進場，有實時量表同淺白提示。
zh.hero_alt: 降落教學嘅歡迎面板，下面係一架喺啟德 IGS 進場嘅 747，有「Start the lesson」按鈕。
zh.hero_caption: 教學由 3,100 呎進場開始，先有一段淺白嘅歡迎。

title: A Map option on the home screen
dek: Choose whether the corner map is on before you start a flight, with a new tick box in the home screen Options.
description: Fly Kai Tak's home screen now has a Map with live aircraft option, so you can start a flight with the corner map on or off. M still toggles it in flight.
hero_alt: The home screen options with the new Map with live aircraft tick box under Computer flies the aircraft.
hero_caption: The new Map option in the home screen Options.
card_title: Map option on the home screen
card_sub: Start with the map on or off

zh.title: 主畫面嘅地圖選項
zh.dek: 主畫面「選項」多咗個剔選格，開始飛行之前就可以揀角落地圖要唔要開。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面而家有「即時飛機地圖」選項，開始飛行時可以揀開或者關角落地圖；飛行途中仍然可以用 M 鍵開關。
zh.hero_alt: 主畫面選項，「Computer flies the aircraft」下面多咗「Map with live aircraft」剔選格。
zh.hero_caption: 主畫面選項入面新增嘅地圖選項。

title: A map toggle with live aircraft
dek: The corner map now shows the other airliners as they fly, taxi and climb, and a Map button (or M) turns it on and off.
description: Fly Kai Tak's corner map now plots the other aircraft live, amber in the air with altitude and grey on the ground, and a Map button or the M key hides it.
hero_alt: The 747 on the IGS approach over Kowloon, with the corner map showing another aircraft in amber with its altitude.
hero_caption: On the IGS 13 approach. The map in the top left shows another aircraft in amber, with its altitude.
card_sub: Press M to show or hide

zh.title: 可以開關嘅即時飛機地圖
zh.dek: 角落地圖而家會顯示其他客機嘅飛行、滑行同爬升，仲有個 Map 掣（或者 M 鍵）可以開關。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅角落地圖而家即時顯示其他飛機：空中係琥珀色同有高度，地面係灰色；Map 掣或者 M 鍵可以收埋。
zh.hero_alt: 747 喺九龍上空 IGS 進場，角落地圖用琥珀色顯示另一部飛機同佢嘅高度。
zh.hero_caption: IGS 13 進場。左上角嘅地圖用琥珀色顯示另一部飛機同佢嘅高度。

title: The Kai Tak terminal, rebuilt to match the chart
dek: The terminal pier now stands at the north-west end of the apron, at right angles to the runway, with eight nose-in stands and three apron lanes.
description: Fly Kai Tak's terminal and apron now follow the Kai Tak chart: a pier at right angles to the runway, eight nose-in stands, lanes D3, D2 and D1, and new taxi routes.
hero_alt: Top-down view of the Kai Tak apron with the terminal pier, eight nose-in stands and three apron lanes.
hero_caption: The new layout from above: pier at the north-west end, eight stands and lanes D3, D2 and D1.

zh.title: 按啟德機場圖重建嘅客運大樓
zh.dek: 客運指廊而家企喺停機坪西北端，同跑道成直角，有八個機頭向內停機位同三條停機坪滑行道。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅客運大樓同停機坪跟返啟德機場圖：同跑道成直角嘅指廊、八個機頭向內停機位、D3、D2、D1 滑行道，同新嘅滑行路線。
zh.hero_alt: 啟德停機坪俯瞰圖，有客運指廊、八個機頭向內停機位同三條停機坪滑行道。
zh.hero_caption: 新佈局俯瞰：西北端指廊、八個機位，同 D3、D2、D1 滑行道。

title: The Flight Board Clatters
dek: Every flap that turns on the flight information board now makes the old clack-clack-clack, with an on/off button.
description: The Fly Kai Tak flight information board now clatters like a real split-flap board whenever a letter changes, on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, with its own on/off button.
hero_alt: Plane Spotter at night from the tower with the split-flap flight board at the top right.
hero_caption: The board at night, from the tower.

zh.title: 航班資訊板有翻牌聲
zh.dek: 航班資訊板每塊翻牌轉動都會發出舊式「咔咔咔」聲，仲有開關掣。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅航班資訊板而家喺字母轉動時會發出翻牌聲，主畫面同觀機模式都有，亦有獨立開關掣。
zh.hero_alt: 夜晚喺塔台觀機，右上角有翻牌式航班資訊板。
zh.hero_caption: 夜晚喺塔台睇資訊板。

title: New: Sun, Moon and Time of Day
dek: A real sun and moon cross the sky, and the light, sky and city follow the clock.
description: Fly Kai Tak now has a sun and moon placed for Hong Kong in 1998, a 24-hour clock with Dawn, Day, Dusk and Night presets, and lighting that follows the sun.
hero_alt: The sun low over the hills west of Kowloon with a pale orange sky.
hero_caption: Sunset at 18:15, looking west.
card_title: Sun, Moon and Time of Day

zh.title: 新功能：日頭、月亮同時間
zh.dek: 真正嘅日頭同月亮喺天空移動，光線、天空同城市跟住時鐘變。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 而家有按 1998 年香港位置嘅日頭同月亮、24 小時時鐘（黎明、日間、黃昏、夜間預設），同埋跟住日頭變化嘅光線。
zh.hero_alt: 日頭低低掛喺九龍西面嘅山上，天空係淡橙色。
zh.hero_caption: 18:15 日落，向西望。

title: The Kai Tak Flight Information Board
dek: An old split-flap board lists every arrival and departure, on the home screen and in Plane Spotter.
description: Fly Kai Tak adds a split-flap flight information board with every arrival and departure, on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, in English and Cantonese.
hero_alt: Plane Spotter from the car park roof with a split-flap flight board at the top right.
hero_caption: The board in Plane Spotter.

zh.title: 啟德航班資訊板
zh.dek: 一塊舊式翻牌板列出每班抵港同離港航班，主畫面同觀機模式都有。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 加入翻牌式航班資訊板，列出每班抵港同離港航班，主畫面同觀機模式都有，支援英文同廣東話。
zh.hero_alt: 喺停車場天台觀機，右上角有翻牌式航班資訊板。
zh.hero_caption: 觀機模式嘅資訊板。

title: Zoom With the Mouse Wheel
dek: Scroll up to zoom in and scroll down to zoom out, in the same 1× to 16× steps as the I and O keys.
description: Fly Kai Tak now zooms with the mouse wheel: scroll up to zoom in, scroll down to zoom out, 1× to 16×, one step per notch.
hero_alt: The 747 on the approach to Kai Tak at 4× zoom.
hero_caption: The approach at 4× zoom.

zh.title: 用滑鼠滾輪縮放
zh.dek: 向上滾放大，向下滾縮小，同 I、O 鍵一樣由 1× 到 16× 分級。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 而家可以用滑鼠滾輪縮放：向上滾放大，向下滾縮小，1× 至 16×，每格一級。
zh.hero_alt: 747 喺 4× 縮放下進場啟德。
zh.hero_caption: 4× 縮放嘅進場視野。

title: Fix: Buildings and Vehicles Clear of Aircraft
dek: The car park and fire station moved out of the pushback lanes, and service vehicles wait out of sight.
description: Fly Kai Tak apron fix: aircraft no longer overlap the car park, the fire station or service vehicles, which now wait out of sight until their aircraft docks.
hero_alt: View from the car park roof along the runway with a jet taxiing on the taxiway.
hero_caption: The view from the car park roof, now east of the stands.

zh.title: 修正：建築物同車輛避開飛機
zh.dek: 停車場同消防局搬離推機路線，地勤車輛會喺視線以外等候。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 停機坪修正：飛機唔會再同停車場、消防局或地勤車輛重疊，車輛會喺視線以外等到飛機泊定先出現。
zh.hero_alt: 喺停車場天台沿跑道望出去，一架客機喺滑行道上滑行。
zh.hero_caption: 停車場天台嘅視野，而家喺停機位東面。

title: Home Screen Shows Your Day, Night and Weather Choices
dek: The live view behind the menu now changes as you pick day or night, weather, clouds and lightning.
description: On the Fly Kai Tak home screen, the live view of Kowloon behind the menu now updates straight away when you toggle day or night, weather, clouds and lightning.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak home screen by day with Storm selected, showing a grey overcast sky over Kowloon behind the menu.
hero_caption: Day with Storm selected: the live view behind the menu changes as you pick.
card_sub: See it before you fly it

zh.title: 主畫面即時顯示日夜同天氣選擇
zh.dek: 揀日間或夜間、天氣、雲同閃電，選單後面嘅實時畫面即刻轉。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面後面嘅九龍實時畫面，而家會即時跟住你揀嘅日間或夜間、天氣、雲同閃電而改變。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 日間主畫面揀咗風暴，選單後面係九龍上空灰濛濛嘅陰天。
zh.hero_caption: 日間配風暴：選單後面嘅實時畫面會跟住你嘅選擇變。

title: New: Aircraft Collisions and Damage
dek: Traffic now keeps clear of other aircraft, and a collision breaks wings and starts fires.
description: Fly Kai Tak aircraft now have collision detection: ground traffic avoids each other, and a collision shows broken wings, scorch marks, smoke and fire.
hero_alt: Two airliners overlapping on the apron with black smoke rising from the contact.
hero_caption: Two aircraft touch on the apron. Smoke rises from the contact point.

zh.title: 新功能：飛機碰撞同損毀
zh.dek: 交通而家會避開其他飛機，萬一相撞，機翼會折斷、起火冒煙。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅飛機有碰撞偵測：地面交通會互相避開，相撞就會見到機翼折斷、燒焦痕跡、冒煙同起火。
zh.hero_alt: 兩架客機喺停機坪重疊，接觸位置冒出黑煙。
zh.hero_caption: 兩架飛機喺停機坪相撞，接觸位置冒煙。

title: New: jet bridges and pushback tugs at the Kai Tak terminal
dek: Aircraft now park nose-in at jet bridges, and a tug pushes each one back when it leaves.
description: Fly Kai Tak adds jet bridges to the Kai Tak terminal. Aircraft taxi in and dock at them, and pushback tugs push each departure back and turn it toward the runway.
hero_alt: Aircraft parked nose-in at the terminal jet bridges, with a 747 being pushed back at the left.
hero_caption: Aircraft at the bridges while a 747 is pushed back.

zh.title: 新增：Kai Tak 客運大樓嘅空橋同推機拖車
zh.dek: 飛機而家機頭向前泊喺空橋度，離開嗰陣由拖車推返出嚟。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 喺 Kai Tak 客運大樓加咗空橋。飛機滑行入場接駁空橋，推機拖車會將離場飛機推後，再轉到對正跑道。
zh.hero_alt: 飛機機頭向前泊喺客運大樓空橋度，左邊有一架 747 被推後。
zh.hero_caption: 飛機泊喺空橋，一架 747 被推後。

title: Apron taxi lines and numbered stands
dek: Yellow guidance lines, red stand boxes and numbered stands show where to taxi and where to park.
description: Fly Kai Tak's apron now has yellow taxi lines, numbered stands, red stand boxes and service road lines, and the other aircraft taxi along them.
hero_alt: The whole apron from above: seven terminal stands in one row, five drive-through stands in another, and the dark lane between them.
hero_caption: The apron from above, with its taxi lines and numbered stands.

zh.title: 停機坪滑行標線同編號停機位
zh.dek: 黃色引導線、紅色停機位框同編號停機位，指示飛機點樣滑行同泊位。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅停機坪而家有黃色滑行引導線、編號停機位、紅色停機位框同服務道路標線，其他飛機亦跟住標線滑行。
zh.hero_alt: 由上面望成個停機坪：一排七個客運大樓停機位、一排五個貫通式停機位，中間係深色車道。
zh.hero_caption: 由上面望停機坪嘅滑行標線同編號停機位。

title: Blog categories, search and pages
dek: Browse the blog by category, sort by category, page through 20 posts at a time and search every post.
description: The Fly Kai Tak blog now has categories, a sort by category view, 20 posts per page and a search box that works in English and Cantonese.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak blog sorted by category, with a heading above each group of posts.
hero_caption: Sort by category groups the posts under their category.
card_sub: Sort, page and search every post

zh.title: 網誌分類、搜尋同分頁
zh.dek: 按分類瀏覽網誌、按分類排序、每頁 20 篇，仲可以搜尋所有文章。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 網誌而家有分類、按分類排序、每頁 20 篇同搜尋框，英文同廣東話都用得。
zh.hero_alt: 按分類排序嘅 Fly Kai Tak 網誌，每組文章上面有分類標題。
zh.hero_caption: 按分類排序會將文章歸入各自嘅分類下面。

title: Fix: the 747 upper-deck hump now has the right shape
dek: A lower, wider hump with a long slope back into the roof, like the real jet.
description: The 747-400 upper-deck hump in Fly Kai Tak was too tall and narrow. It is now lower and wider with a long shallow slope into the roof, like the real 747.
hero_alt: Side view of a 747-400 on the runway with a low upper-deck hump sloping gently back into the roof.
hero_caption: The reshaped 747 hump from the side.

zh.title: 修正：747 上層艙隆起部分形狀更準確
zh.dek: 隆起較低較闊，後面有長斜坡接返機頂，同真正 747 更加似。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅 747-400 上層艙隆起之前太高太窄，而家改成較低較闊，後面有長而平緩嘅斜坡接返機頂，更似真正 747。
zh.hero_alt: 747-400 喺跑道上嘅側面圖，上層艙隆起較低，並向後平緩斜落機頂。
zh.hero_caption: 重新設計後嘅 747 隆起側面。

title: New: Plane Spotter on Runway 31
dek: Watch the easterly traffic from the spectator spots and the new Lei Yue Mun view.
description: Fly Kai Tak Plane Spotter now has a Runway 31 mode: arrivals over Lei Yue Mun, departures toward Kowloon City, and a Lei Yue Mun spectator view.
hero_alt: Night view from Lei Yue Mun of a 747 on approach to Runway 31 with its landing lights on.
hero_caption: An arrival seen from the Lei Yue Mun spot.

zh.title: 新功能：31 號跑道觀機
zh.dek: 喺觀機位置同新增嘅鯉魚門視角睇東面進場嘅飛機。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 觀機模式而家有 31 號跑道：抵港航班經鯉魚門進場，離港航班向九龍城起飛，仲有鯉魚門觀機視角。
zh.hero_alt: 夜晚喺鯉魚門望出去，一架開住降落燈嘅 747 正進場 31 號跑道。
zh.hero_caption: 喺鯉魚門觀機位置睇抵港航班。

title: New: take off from Runway 31 in free flight
dek: Line up at the Kowloon Bay end, point at Kowloon City, then climb and turn left.
description: Fly Kai Tak free flight now starts on Runway 31 as well as Runway 13, with Runway 31 radio calls, mirrored airport traffic and a climb out over Kowloon City.
hero_alt: Night view of a 747-400 lined up on Runway 31 with the runway lights ahead and the lights of Kowloon beyond.
hero_caption: Lined up on Runway 31 at night.
card_sub: Free flight from the bay end

zh.title: 新功能：自由飛行可以喺 31 號跑道起飛
zh.dek: 喺九龍灣嗰一頭對正，機頭向住九龍城，然後爬升同向左轉。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 自由飛行而家除咗 13 號跑道，亦可以由 31 號跑道開始，有 31 號跑道無線電、鏡像機場交通，同飛越九龍城嘅離場。
zh.hero_alt: 夜晚 747-400 對正 31 號跑道，前方係跑道燈同遠處九龍嘅燈光。
zh.hero_caption: 夜晚對正 31 號跑道。

title: New: a take-off lesson for first-time pilots
dek: A guided take-off on Runway 13: full thrust, steer, rotate, gear up, autopilot. No experience needed.
description: Fly Kai Tak now has a Take-off lesson: a coach panel walks first-time pilots through a Runway 13 take-off in eight steps with live meters and plain-language tips.
hero_alt: The Take-off lesson welcome panel above a 747 lined up on Runway 13 at Kai Tak, with a Start the lesson button.
hero_caption: The lesson starts lined up on Runway 13 with a plain-language welcome.
card_sub: A guided first flight for non-pilots

zh.title: 新增：俾初學者嘅起飛教學
zh.dek: 喺 13 號跑道一步一步學起飛：推滿油門、轉向、拉機頭、收起落架、自動駕駛。唔使有經驗。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 新增起飛教學：教練面板分八步帶初學者喺 13 號跑道起飛，有實時量表同淺白提示。
zh.hero_alt: 起飛教學嘅歡迎面板，下面係一架停喺啟德 13 號跑道起點嘅 747，有「Start the lesson」按鈕。
zh.hero_caption: 教學由 13 號跑道起點開始，先有一段淺白嘅歡迎。

title: Fix: no more false "too low" calls after take-off
dek: The gear and flap warnings now only sound when you are descending.
description: Fly Kai Tak fix: the "Too low, gear" and "Too low, flaps" warnings no longer fire on take-off. They need a descent now; the IGS 13 approach is unchanged.
hero_alt: A 777 climbing out over Kowloon Bay with the gear coming up and no warning on the display.
hero_caption: Climb-out with the gear coming up, and no false warning.

zh.title: 修正：起飛後唔會再有錯誤嘅「太低」警告
zh.dek: 起落架同襟翼警告而家只會喺下降時先響。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 修正：「Too low, gear」同「Too low, flaps」警告唔會再喺起飛時響，要下降先會觸發；IGS 13 進場冇變。
zh.hero_alt: 777 喺九龍灣上空爬升，起落架收緊，顯示器冇任何警告。
zh.hero_caption: 爬升收起落架，冇錯誤警告。

title: New: ground vehicles on the Kai Tak apron
dek: Buses, catering trucks, baggage trains, freight trucks and a fire station now work around the parked aircraft.
description: Fly Kai Tak adds airport ground vehicles: buses, catering trucks that lift to the door, baggage tractors with loaded carts, container and box freight trucks, and fire tenders at a fire station.
hero_alt: A bus and a catering truck with its box raised at the front door of a parked 747.
hero_caption: A bus and a catering truck at a stand.

zh.title: 新增：啟德停機坪地勤車輛
zh.dek: 巴士、餐飲車、行李車隊、貨車同消防局而家喺停泊嘅飛機附近工作。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 新增機場地勤車輛：巴士、可升降到機門嘅餐飲車、拖住行李車嘅拖車、貨櫃同箱式貨車，以及消防局嘅消防車。
zh.hero_alt: 一架停泊嘅 747 前門旁邊有一部巴士同一部升起車箱嘅餐飲車。
zh.hero_caption: 停機位上嘅巴士同餐飲車。

title: New: easterly approach to Runway 31
dek: Fly in from the east through the Lei Yue Mun gap, by day or at night.
description: Fly Kai Tak adds a Runway 31 approach: a straight-in final over the sea, through the Lei Yue Mun gap and across Kowloon Bay, with its own lights, PAPI, radio calls, traffic and spotter view.
hero_alt: Night approach to Runway 31 through the Lei Yue Mun gap, with city lights on both sides and the runway lights ahead.
hero_caption: Through the Lei Yue Mun gap at night.

zh.title: 新功能：31 號跑道東面進場
zh.dek: 由東面穿過鯉魚門進場，日夜都飛得。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 加入 31 號跑道進場：喺海面直線進場，穿過鯉魚門，橫過九龍灣，有專屬燈光、PAPI、無線電、交通同觀機視角。
zh.hero_alt: 夜間穿過鯉魚門進場 31 號跑道，兩邊係城市燈光，前方係跑道燈。
zh.hero_caption: 夜晚穿過鯉魚門。

title: Update: a High scores button on the home screen
dek: Open and close the high score table from the top left of the home screen.
description: Fly Kai Tak update: a High scores button on the home screen opens and closes the table of ranked landings, from Captain down to Cadet.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak home screen with the High scores panel open at the top left, listing landings ranked from Captain downwards.
hero_caption: The high score table opened from the home screen.
card_sub: Open the table from the home screen

zh.title: 更新：主畫面加入最高分掣
zh.dek: 喺主畫面左上角打開同收埋最高分榜。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 更新：主畫面嘅最高分掣可以打開同收埋降落排名榜，由機長排到見習機師。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面，左上角打開咗最高分面板，列出由機長開始排名嘅降落紀錄。
zh.hero_caption: 喺主畫面打開最高分榜。

title: New: share your score and report card
dek: Post your grade to X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp or Threads, or save the report card as an image.
description: Fly Kai Tak's result screen now has share buttons for X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp, Threads and email, plus a downloadable report card image.
hero_alt: The result screen after a night landing on Runway 13, with grade B, the touchdown stats and a row of share buttons.
hero_caption: The result screen after a night landing, with the new share row.
card_sub: Report card for X, Facebook and more

zh.title: 新增：分享你嘅成績同成績表
zh.dek: 將評級貼去 X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp 或 Threads，或者將成績表儲存做圖片。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅結果畫面而家有分享掣，可以分享去 X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp、Threads 同電郵，仲可以下載成績表圖片。
zh.hero_alt: 夜間降落 13 號跑道之後嘅結果畫面，有評級 B、接地數據，同一排分享掣。
zh.hero_caption: 夜間降落之後嘅結果畫面，新增咗分享掣。

title: New: a high score table with Captain and First Officer ranks
dek: Hand-fly the IGS 13 approach and your landing goes on a saved high score table, ranked from Captain down to Cadet.
description: Fly Kai Tak now has a high score table. Land the IGS 13 approach by hand to rank as Captain, First Officer, Second Officer, Flight Engineer or Cadet.
hero_alt: The result screen after a landing: score 88, a callsign box, the rank First Officer and the top five of the high score table.
hero_caption: Your rank, your position and the top five.

zh.title: 新功能：最高分榜，設機長同副機長官階
zh.dek: 親手駕駛 IGS 13 進場，降落就會上榜，官階由機長排到見習機師。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 而家有最高分榜。親手降落 IGS 13 進場，就可以獲得機長、副機長、第二副機師、飛行機械師或見習機師官階。
zh.hero_alt: 降落後嘅結果畫面：88 分、呼號輸入框、官階「副機長」，同埋最高分榜頭五名。
zh.hero_caption: 你嘅官階、排名同頭五名。

title: New: giant billboards and neon over Kowloon
dek: Floodlit hoardings on the airport road and glowing neon signs, visible from the IGS at night.
description: Fly Kai Tak now has 1990s-style giant floodlit billboards on Kowloon rooftops and roadsides, plus glowing neon signs. Brands are invented; no real logos.
hero_alt: Night view down the IGS approach over Kowloon with floodlit billboards and red and magenta neon signs on the rooftops.
hero_caption: Floodlit hoardings and neon on the rooftops, from the IGS at night.

zh.title: 新增：九龍巨型廣告牌同霓虹
zh.dek: 機場路上嘅泛光燈廣告牌，同發光嘅霓虹招牌，夜間 IGS 進場睇得到。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 而家有九十年代風格嘅巨型泛光燈廣告牌，企喺九龍天台同路邊，仲有發光霓虹招牌。品牌係虛構，冇真實商標。
zh.hero_alt: 夜間沿 IGS 進場望落九龍，天台上有泛光燈廣告牌同紅色、洋紅色霓虹招牌。
zh.hero_caption: 夜間喺 IGS 進場睇到天台上嘅泛光燈廣告牌同霓虹。

title: Plane spotter viewpoints: the car park roof and the Peak
dek: Where Kai Tak's spotters stood: the airport car park roof and the Peak, with a little history and how to watch from both in the sim.
description: The history of two Kai Tak plane spotting viewpoints, the airport car park roof and the Peak, and how to watch from both in Fly Kai Tak's Plane Spotter mode.
hero_alt: The view from the Kai Tak car park roof: a jet on the apron, Runway 13 running out into the harbour and the skyline across the water.
hero_caption: The car park roof in the sim, with Runway 13 running into the harbour.
card_sub: The car park roof and the Peak

zh.title: 觀機位置：停車場天台同山頂
zh.dek: 啟德發燒友企邊度睇飛機：機場停車場天台同山頂，加啲背景，仲有喺模擬器入面點樣喺兩個地方觀機。
zh.description: 啟德兩個觀機位置嘅背景：機場停車場天台同山頂，以及喺 Fly Kai Tak 嘅 Plane Spotter 模式入面點樣喺兩個地方觀機。
zh.hero_alt: 喺啟德停車場天台望出去：停機坪上有一架客機，13 號跑道伸出海港，對岸係天際線。
zh.hero_caption: 模擬器入面嘅停車場天台，13 號跑道伸出海港。

title: Update: the rotate prompt is gone
dek: The sim now plays in portrait or landscape with nothing in the way. Landscape is still recommended.
description: Fly Kai Tak mobile update: the Turn your phone sideways prompt is removed, so the sim plays in either orientation. Begin descent still asks for landscape full screen.
hero_alt: Landscape phone view of the IGS approach with the yoke bottom left, gear, flaps and thrust lever bottom right, and a compact toolbar.
hero_caption: Landscape on a phone, with no prompt in the way.

zh.title: 更新：旋轉提示已移除
zh.dek: 而家直向橫向都可以直接玩，無提示擋住。橫向仍然係建議嘅玩法。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 手機版更新：移除「Turn your phone sideways」提示，直向橫向都可以玩。Begin descent 仍然會要求橫向全螢幕。
zh.hero_alt: 電話橫向畫面，顯示 IGS 進場，左下角係操縱桿，右下角係起落架、襟翼同推力桿，頂部係精簡工具列。
zh.hero_caption: 電話橫向畫面，唔會有提示擋住。

title: Fix: the rotate prompt now clears when you turn your phone
dek: The portrait prompt follows the real window size, and iPhone players get a tip about Portrait Orientation Lock.
description: Fly Kai Tak mobile fix: the rotate prompt now clears when the window turns landscape, with a hint for iPhone players whose Portrait Orientation Lock is on.
hero_alt: A phone in portrait showing the Turn your phone sideways prompt with a hint about Portrait Orientation Lock.
hero_caption: The rotate prompt, now with a hint for iPhone players.
card_sub: Clears when you turn your phone

zh.title: 修正：轉橫電話後，旋轉提示會自動消失
zh.dek: 提示而家跟住視窗嘅真實大小，iPhone 玩家仲有直向鎖定嘅提示。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 手機版修正：視窗轉橫後旋轉提示會消失，iPhone 玩家如開咗直向鎖定亦有提示。
zh.hero_alt: 電話直向，畫面顯示「Turn your phone sideways」提示，同有關直向鎖定嘅提示。
zh.hero_caption: 旋轉提示，而家加咗俾 iPhone 玩家嘅提示。

title: Redrawn aircraft: embedded cockpits and real winglets
dek: The cockpit glass is cut into the fuselage, the winglets are swept blades and the wings taper, on all four aircraft.
description: Fly Kai Tak update: the 747-400, 777-200, A330-300 and A340-300 are redrawn with embedded cockpit glass, swept winglets and tapered wings.
hero_alt: A 747-400 seen from ahead and below, with its upper deck rising behind the nose and the windscreen set into the skin.
hero_caption: The 747-400 upper deck, with the windscreen set into the skin.
card_sub: Embedded cockpits, swept winglets, tapered wings

zh.title: 重新畫過嘅飛機：嵌入式駕駛艙同翼尖小翼
zh.dek: 四款飛機嘅駕駛艙玻璃開喺機身表面，小翼向後掠，機翼亦愈近翼尖愈薄。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 更新：747-400、777-200、A330-300 同 A340-300 重新畫過，駕駛艙玻璃嵌入機身，小翼向後掠，機翼收窄。
zh.hero_alt: 由前面下方望住一架 747-400，上層喺機鼻後面隆起，擋風玻璃嵌入表面。
zh.hero_caption: 747-400 嘅上層，擋風玻璃嵌入表面。

title: Aircraft now turn smoothly on the ground
dek: Other jets used to snap to a new heading at every corner of the taxi route. They now curve through each turn and ease their speed.
description: Fly Kai Tak fix: other aircraft snapped to a new heading at every taxi corner. They now curve through turns, ease their speed and line up on the runway.
hero_alt: A 747 seen from above and behind, curving through a turn on the taxiway beside the runway.
hero_caption: An arrival curving through its turn at the end of the runway.
card_sub: Other aircraft now curve through corners

zh.title: 飛機而家喺地面順滑咁轉彎
zh.dek: 其他飛機之前喺滑行路線每個轉角都突然轉向，而家會順滑咁彎過，速度亦會平順轉變。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 修正：其他飛機喺滑行轉角會突然轉向，而家會順滑咁轉彎、平順加減速，並對正跑道排隊。
zh.hero_alt: 由高處後面望住一架 747，喺跑道旁邊嘅滑行道上轉彎。
zh.hero_caption: 一架進場飛機喺跑道尾嘅轉彎入面。

title: The airlines and aircraft of Kai Tak
dek: Seven carriers, the jets they flew and how they looked on the apron, with a short history of each.
description: A guide to the airlines and aircraft types at Kai Tak in the 1990s: Cathay Pacific, Dragonair, Qantas, BA, Singapore, Thai and JAL, with brief histories.
hero_alt: Spectator view from the car park roof: a white jet with a dark green tail on the apron, another aircraft on the runway, and the Kowloon skyline and hills beyond.
hero_caption: The view from the car park roof in the sim.
card_sub: Who flew into Kai Tak, and what they flew

zh.title: 啟德機場嘅航空公司同機型
zh.dek: 七間航空公司、佢哋飛嘅機型，同停機坪上面嘅外觀，仲有每間嘅簡短歷史。
zh.description: 介紹九十年代啟德機場嘅航空公司同機型：國泰、港龍、澳洲航空、英航、新航、泰航同日航，附簡短歷史。
zh.hero_alt: 喺停車場天台望出去：停機坪上有一架白色、深綠色尾翼嘅客機，跑道上有另一架飛機，遠處係九龍嘅高樓同山嶺。
zh.hero_caption: 模擬器入面喺停車場天台望出去嘅景色。

title: Other aircraft now bank the right way
dek: Arriving and departing jets were drawn rolling away from their turns. They now dip the wing on the inside of the turn.
description: Fly Kai Tak fix: other aircraft were drawn banking the wrong way in turns. Arrivals and departures now dip the inside wing, as real jets do.
hero_alt: A 747 seen from behind in a right turn over Kowloon City, with its right wing lower than the left.
hero_caption: An arrival in its right turn, with the right wing down.
card_sub: Other aircraft now roll into their turns

zh.title: 其他飛機而家向啱嘅方向傾側
zh.dek: 進場同離場嘅客機之前轉彎時向反方向傾側，而家會將轉彎內側嗰邊機翼向下。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 修正：其他飛機轉彎時傾側方向反咗，進場同離場客機而家會將內側機翼向下，同真正客機一樣。
zh.hero_alt: 由後面望住一架 747 喺九龍城上空右轉，右翼比左翼低。
zh.hero_caption: 一架進場飛機喺右轉中，右翼向下。

title: Read the Fly Kai Tak blog in Cantonese
dek: Every blog page now has an EN / 粵 button that switches the whole post between English and Cantonese, and shares your choice with the home screen.
description: The Fly Kai Tak blog now has an English / Cantonese toggle on every page: posts, captions, header and footer switch to written Cantonese.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak blog index in Cantonese, with the EN and 粵 button in the header.
hero_caption: The Blog index in Cantonese. The EN / 粵 button is in the header.
card_sub: EN / 粵 on every blog page

zh.title: 用廣東話睇 Fly Kai Tak 網誌
zh.dek: 每一頁網誌而家都有 EN / 粵 掣，可以將成篇文章喺英文同廣東話之間切換，並同首頁共用你嘅選擇。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 網誌每頁都有英文／廣東話切換：文章、圖片說明、頁首同頁尾都可以轉做書面粵語。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 網誌首頁嘅廣東話版本，頁首有 EN 同粵掣。
zh.hero_caption: 廣東話版網誌首頁。EN / 粵 掣喺頁首。

title: Fly Kai Tak in Cantonese: a language toggle on the home screen
dek: A new EN / 粵 button on the home screen switches all of the setup text between English and Cantonese, and remembers your choice.
description: Fly Kai Tak's home screen now has an English / Cantonese toggle: the whole setup screen switches to written Cantonese and remembers your choice.
hero_alt: The Fly Kai Tak setup screen in Cantonese, with the EN and 粵 button at the top left.
hero_caption: The setup screen in Cantonese. The EN / 粵 button is at the top left.
card_sub: EN / 粵 toggle on the home screen

zh.title: 用廣東話玩 Fly Kai Tak：首頁語言切換
zh.dek: 首頁新增 EN / 粵 掣，可以將所有設定文字喺英文同廣東話之間切換，並會記住你嘅選擇。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 首頁而家有英文／廣東話切換：成個設定畫面轉做書面粵語，並記住你嘅選擇。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 設定畫面嘅廣東話版本，左上角有 EN 同粵掣。
zh.hero_caption: 廣東話版設定畫面。EN / 粵 掣喺左上角。

title: The Peak Tram, the Peak Lookout and a view from the Peak
dek: Ride the Peak Tram up from Garden Road, find the Peak Lookout beside the Peak Tower, and watch the approach from the top of the Peak.
description: Fly Kai Tak adds the Peak Tram, the Peak Lookout and a Spectator: The Peak view, alongside Ocean Park's cable car between the Waterfront and the Summit.
hero_alt: The view from the Peak over the harbour to Kowloon.
hero_caption: Spectator: The Peak, looking over the harbour to Kowloon.
card_sub: Peak Tram, Peak Lookout and a view from the top

zh.title: 山頂纜車、山頂餐廳同山頂景色
zh.dek: 由花園道搭山頂纜車上山，喺凌霄閣旁邊搵到山頂餐廳，再喺山頂睇飛機進場。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 加入山頂纜車、山頂餐廳同「Plane Spotter: The Peak」視角，仲有海洋公園海濱同山上之間嘅纜車。
zh.hero_alt: 由山頂望過海港去九龍嘅景色。
zh.hero_caption: Plane Spotter: The Peak，望過海港去九龍。

title: An inverted yoke for touch and mouse: drag down to pull up
dek: The on-screen yoke now works like a real control column: drag down to pull the nose up, drag up to push it down, with touch or a mouse.
description: Fly Kai Tak's on-screen yoke is now inverted for touch and mouse: drag down to pull the nose up, drag up to push it down, matching the keyboard.
hero_alt: The 747 on the IGS approach, with the round on-screen yoke in the bottom left corner.
hero_caption: The on-screen yoke, bottom left, works with touch or a mouse.
card_sub: Drag down to pull up, with touch or mouse

zh.title: 觸控同滑鼠嘅反向操縱桿：向下拖就拉起
zh.dek: 螢幕上嘅操縱桿而家好似真正嘅操縱柱：向下拖就拉起機頭，向上拖就壓低機頭，觸控或滑鼠都得。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅螢幕操縱桿而家為觸控同滑鼠反向：向下拖拉起機頭，向上拖壓低機頭，同鍵盤一致。
zh.hero_alt: 747 沿 IGS 進場，左下角有個圓形螢幕操縱桿。
zh.hero_caption: 左下角嘅螢幕操縱桿，觸控或滑鼠都用得。

title: Share Fly Kai Tak posts on Threads
dek: Every blog post now has a Threads share button alongside X, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email and copy link.
description: Fly Kai Tak blog posts can now be shared on Threads with one click, with the title and link pre-filled.
hero_alt: The Bank of China Tower and the Central skyline in Fly Kai Tak.
hero_caption: Found a view you like? Share the post it came from.
card_sub: A new share button on every post

zh.title: 喺 Threads 分享 Fly Kai Tak 文章
zh.dek: 每篇網誌文章而家都有 Threads 分享掣，同 X、Facebook、Reddit、LinkedIn、WhatsApp、電郵同複製連結放埋一齊。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 網誌文章而家可以一㩒分享去 Threads，標題同連結已預先填好。
zh.hero_alt: Fly Kai Tak 入面嘅中銀大廈同中環天際線。
zh.hero_caption: 發現鍾意嘅畫面？將佢嘅來源文章分享出去。

title: Landmarks tour, plus Ocean Park and Happy Valley
dek: From the Bank of China Tower to the Garden Hill beacon: the landmarks you can spot around Kai Tak, and two new additions, Ocean Park and Happy Valley Racecourse.
description: A tour of the Hong Kong landmarks in Fly Kai Tak, with screenshots, plus the new Ocean Park amusement park and Happy Valley Racecourse.
hero_alt: The Bank of China Tower's braced, faceted shaft among the Central towers.
hero_caption: The Bank of China Tower and the Central skyline.
card_sub: Plus Ocean Park and Happy Valley

zh.title: 地標導覽，另加海洋公園同跑馬地
zh.dek: 由中銀大廈到嘉頓山障礙物燈：啟德四周你可以認出嘅地標，仲有兩個新增景點：海洋公園同跑馬地馬場。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 入面香港地標嘅導覽連截圖，仲有新加入嘅海洋公園同跑馬地馬場。
zh.hero_alt: 中銀大廈有斜撐、刻面嘅塔身，喺中環高樓之間。
zh.hero_caption: 中銀大廈同中環天際線。

title: Flying Kai Tak on your phone: landscape, a cleaner toolbar and bigger controls
dek: A one-row toolbar with a More drawer, touch controls sized for short landscape screens, and a prompt that asks portrait players to turn the phone sideways.
description: Fly Kai Tak on mobile: a compact toolbar with a More drawer, landscape touch controls, a rotate prompt for portrait, full screen on Begin descent and safe-area support.
hero_alt: A 747-400 on the IGS approach in a landscape phone window, with the yoke bottom left and gear, flaps and thrust lever bottom right.
hero_caption: The IGS approach on a phone-sized landscape screen: a one-row toolbar, the yoke on the left and the gear, flaps and thrust lever on the right.
card_title: Fly Kai Tak on your phone
card_sub: Landscape, a cleaner toolbar, bigger controls

zh.title: 用手機飛啟德：橫向、更精簡嘅工具列同更大嘅控制掣
zh.dek: 一行工具列加 More 抽屜、啱晒短身橫向螢幕嘅觸控控制，仲有提示直向玩家轉橫手機。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 手機版：精簡工具列加 More 抽屜、橫向觸控控制、直向旋轉提示、開始下降時全螢幕，仲支援安全區域。
zh.hero_alt: 橫向手機視窗入面嘅 747-400 沿 IGS 進場，左下角係操縱桿，右下角係起落架、襟翼同推力桿。
zh.hero_caption: 手機大小嘅橫向螢幕上嘅 IGS 進場：一行工具列，左邊係操縱桿，右邊係起落架、襟翼同推力桿。

title: The checkerboard turn: flying the IGS 13 approach
dek: Descend over Tsing Yi, aim at a checkerboard on a hill in Kowloon, then turn a 747 right by 47° over the rooftops. How the Runway 13 approach works in Fly Kai Tak.
description: How the famous Runway 13 IGS approach into Kai Tak works in Fly Kai Tak: the 088° course, the checkerboard on the hill, the 47° right turn over Kowloon City and the landing grade.
hero_alt: Cockpit view of a 747 banking right over Kowloon City with Kai Tak's Runway 13 and the harbour ahead.
hero_caption: Mid-turn in the 747-400. The heading has swung from 088° to 102°, the artificial horizon is banked, and Runway 13 is in sight beyond the sports ground.

zh.title: 棋盤轉彎：飛 IGS 13 進場
zh.dek: 喺青衣上空下降，瞄準九龍山上嘅棋盤，然後喺屋頂上空將 747 向右轉 47°。Fly Kai Tak 入面 13 號跑道進場點運作。
zh.description: 著名嘅啟德 13 號跑道 IGS 進場喺 Fly Kai Tak 點運作：088° 航道、山上棋盤、九龍城上空 47° 右轉，同降落評分。
zh.hero_alt: 747 駕駛艙視角，向右傾斜飛越九龍城，前方係啟德 13 號跑道同海港。
zh.hero_caption: 747-400 轉彎途中。航向已由 088° 轉到 102°，人工地平儀傾斜，13 號跑道喺運動場後面出現。

title: Real Hong Kong: building 1998 from open data
dek: The coastline, roads and about 24,000 buildings under the Kai Tak approach come from official Hong Kong open data. Here is what is real, and what we changed to make it 1998.
description: How Fly Kai Tak builds Hong Kong from Lands Department open data and SRTM terrain, and the 1998 corrections: no Kai Tak redevelopment, no West Kowloon buildings, and the Walled City as an option.
hero_alt: A 747 on the apron at Kai Tak with the runway running out into Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline behind.
hero_caption: Spectator mode from the car park roof: the apron, Runway 13 running into the harbour, and the skyline across the water.

zh.title: 真實香港：用開放數據建構 1998 年
zh.dek: 啟德進場航道下面嘅海岸線、道路同約 24,000 幢建築物，來自香港官方開放數據。呢度講吓邊啲係真，同我哋點樣將佢變返 1998 年。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 點樣用地政總署開放數據同 SRTM 地形建構香港，同 1998 年嘅修正：冇啟德重建、冇西九龍大廈，仲有可以揀嘅九龍寨城。
zh.hero_alt: 啟德停機坪上嘅一架 747，跑道伸出維多利亞港，後面係香港天際線。
zh.hero_caption: 喺停車場天台觀機：停機坪、伸出海港嘅 13 號跑道，同對岸嘅天際線。

title: Typhoons, fog and city lights: weather and night at Kai Tak
dek: Six weather presets, a lightning toggle, gusts that push the aircraft around and a night mode that lights up Kowloon. The same approach, very different flights.
description: Weather and night flying in Fly Kai Tak: clear, rain, typhoon, storm, low cloud and fog presets, wind gusts and turbulence, lightning, and a lit-up Kowloon at night.
hero_alt: Cockpit view of a 777 on the IGS approach in a typhoon, with heavy rain and the city fading into grey.
hero_caption: The 777-200 on the IGS in a typhoon. The ATC call quotes the live QNH, and the wind readout shows 36 knots gusting 52.

zh.title: 颱風、大霧同城市燈海：啟德嘅天氣同夜間飛行
zh.dek: 六個天氣預設、一個閃電開關、會推動飛機嘅陣風，仲有照亮九龍嘅夜間模式。同一個進場，完全唔同嘅飛行。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 嘅天氣同夜間飛行：晴朗、落雨、颱風、雷暴、低雲同大霧預設，陣風同亂流，閃電，以及夜晚亮晒嘅九龍。
zh.hero_alt: 777 喺颱風入面沿 IGS 進場嘅駕駛艙視角，大雨傾盆，城市消失喺灰色入面。
zh.hero_caption: 777-200 喺颱風中沿 IGS 進場。無線電報出實時 QNH，風速顯示 36 節，陣風 52 節。
